name: @itsmeadarsh/warper
description: Ultra-fast React virtualization library - 120+ FPS, 10M+ items, powered by Rust/WASM
author: Adarsh

scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run copy:wasm && tsc && mkdir -p dist/wasm && cp wasm/warper_wasm.js wasm/warper_wasm.d.ts wasm/warper_wasm_bg.wasm wasm/warper_wasm_bg.wasm.d.ts dist/wasm/
scripts.build:wasm: cd wasm/rust && wasm-pack build --target web --release && rm -f pkg/.gitignore
scripts.copy:wasm: cp wasm/rust/pkg/warper_wasm.js wasm/rust/pkg/warper_wasm.d.ts wasm/rust/pkg/warper_wasm_bg.wasm wasm/rust/pkg/warper_wasm_bg.wasm.d.ts wasm/
scripts.build:examples: mkdir -p examples-dist && cp examples/index.html examples-dist/ && bun vite build --config examples/list/vite.config.ts --outDir ../../examples-dist/list && bun vite build --config examples/grid/vite.config.ts --outDir ../../examples-dist/grid && bun vite build --config examples/one-million-rows/vite.config.ts --outDir ../../examples-dist/one-million-rows && bun vite build --config examples/chat/vite.config.ts --outDir ../../examples-dist/chat && bun vite build --config examples/tree/vite.config.ts --outDir ../../examples-dist/tree
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:examples
